title: [CRY-24] External commits and external proposals are not addressed
description: Review finding CRY-24: External commits and external proposals are not addressed (lens CRY). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:48-53. Fix: The gap is real. A grep finds no "external commit", "new_member" or "external_pub" in spec/, so a conforming client would accept a valid `new_member_commit` (RFC 9420 §12.4.3.2). Adjustment to the threat: no Agora flow publishes GroupInfo, and external proposals already require an `external_senders` extension (§12.1.8). An outsider can therefore join only if a current member leaks GroupInfo with `external_pub`. That route skips the joiner-side adder check of 04:78, which a colluding joiner could ignore in any case, hence P3. Fix as proposed: clients MUST reject `new_member_commit`, `new_member_proposal` and `external` senders, and MUST NOT include `external_pub`. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
